cases.sentence: Долго ли будешь ты так говорить? Твои ___ — буйный ветер
cases.translation: How long will you speak these things? Your words are a mighty wind
cases.explain: Слова (words) is the subject of the implied verb and stands in the nominative plural case.

cases.sentence: Если ты воззовешь к ___ и помолишься всемогущему
cases.translation: If you appeal to God and pray to the Almighty
cases.explain: The verb воззовешь (appeal) with the preposition к (to) requires the dative case.

cases.sentence: Спроси прежнее поколение, рассмотри, что узнали их ___
cases.translation: Ask the prior generation, consider what their forefathers learned
cases.explain: The verb узнали (learned) with the plural requires the genitive of possession.

cases.translation: Can papyrus grow where there is no marsh?
cases.explain: The negative нет (there is not) requires the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Таков удел всех, кто забыл ___, и умирает надежда безбожников
cases.translation: Such is the fate of all who forget God, and the hope of the godless dies
cases.explain: The verb забыл (forgot) requires the genitive case of the object.

cases.sentence: Прежнее тебе покажется ничтожным, настолько велико будет твое ___
cases.translation: What was before will seem insignificant to you; so great will be your future
cases.explain: Будущее (future) is a predicate nominative after the linking verb будет and stands in the nominative case.

cases.sentence: Пробиваются они меж камней, а когда их исторгнут с прежнего ___, само место от них отречется
cases.translation: They pierce through the rocks, but when they are torn from their place, the place will deny them
cases.explain: The preposition с (from) requires the genitive case.

reading.ru: Долго ли будешь ты так говорить? Твои слова — буйный ветер.
reading.question: How does Bildad characterize Job's words?
reading.explain: Bildad tells Job that his words are like a mighty wind—much noise and fury with no substance.

reading.ru: Если твои дети согрешили против Него, Он отдал их во власть их греха
reading.question: What does Bildad say happened to Job's children?
options: They were delivered into the hand of their transgression
reading.correct: They were delivered into the hand of their transgression
reading.explain: Bildad suggests that if Job's children sinned against God, He delivered them into the power of their own sin.

reading.ru: Если ты воззовешь к Богу и помолишься всемогущему, если ты чист и праведен, то и ныне поднимется он для тебя
reading.question: What does Bildad promise if Job is pure and upright?
options: God will arise for him and restore him to his place
God will send him great wealth
God will give him a new family
reading.correct: God will arise for him and restore him to his place
reading.explain: Bildad promises that if Job truly appeals to God and is pure and upright, God will surely rouse Himself and act on his behalf.

reading.ru: Растет ли папирус, где нет болот? Поднимается ли тростник без влаги?
reading.question: What point is Bildad making with these questions about plants?
options: That plants cannot grow without proper conditions, just as people cannot flourish without obedience to God
That papyrus is useless and trostnik is beautiful
That all plants in the land are dying
That water comes only during certain seasons
reading.correct: That plants cannot grow without proper conditions, just as people cannot flourish without obedience to God
reading.explain: Bildad uses these rhetorical questions to illustrate that just as plants need marshes and water to grow, so too people need righteousness to flourish.

reading.ru: Таков удел всех, кто забыл Бога, и умирает надежда безбожников
reading.question: What is the fate of those who forget God according to Bildad?
options: Their hope dies and their confidence fails
They are blessed by God forever
reading.correct: Their hope dies and their confidence fails
reading.explain: Bildad teaches that this is the fate of all who forget God — the hope of the godless perishes.

reading.ru: И так не отвергнет Бог беспорочного и не поддержит руки злодея, он наполнит еще смехом твои уста и ликованием губы твои
reading.question: What will God do for Job if he repents and turns back to Him?
options: Fill his mouth with laughter and his lips with shouting
Make him a slave to his enemies
reading.correct: Fill his mouth with laughter and his lips with shouting
reading.explain: Bildad ends his speech with the promise that God will not reject the blameless; He will fill Job's mouth with laughter and his lips with joyful shouting.
